about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Transferred Fifth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We pray You, almighty God, that we may obtain that salvation whose pledge we have received in this divine sacrament. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
